item.title: The Remarkable Theorem of Gauss
item.author: harisankar.b@niser.ac.in (Harisankar B)
item.description: Gauss’s Theorema Egregium reveals that Gaussian curvature is intrinsic: it can be read from distances measured on a surface, without looking at the surrounding 3D space.
